title: Grateful Dead Live at Musikhalle on 1972-04-29
source: Source: Unknown mics > Uher 4400 > Master Reel > PCM > DAT (44.1k) - Taped by Wolsander* and provided by Tim Dalton; Tansfer: Dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/44.1 - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: Wav > Adobe Audition 3 > iZotope RX 6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick May 2018

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1972 European concert captured on a crisp audience tape, offering a well‑played set and excellent hall sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the show’s intensity – one even attended and called it one of the greatest ever, noting the marathon set that ran past midnight. The recording, sourced from balcony microphones (AUD), delivers clear hall acoustics with low crowd ambience, making it a standout audience tape despite a missing second encore of "Uncle John's Band".

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on performance and good‑to‑excellent audio quality, but only two detailed reviews limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balcony‑rail microphones provide clear hall sound with low crowd ambience; noted as a "real treat" despite missing the second encore of Uncle John's Band.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Extended, high‑energy set that ran well past midnight until power was cut, maintaining strong momentum throughout.
